description: Step 2 of the Kia MFA bootstrap (cmm/sendOTP): deliver a one-time passcode to the account by SMS or email. Takes the `otpKey` and `xid` from kia_start_login — it cannot run without them, which is why it has no separate confirmation gate. Ask the user which channel they want (kia_start_login reports the masked destinations Kia has on file). The passcode expires in about two minutes; `expiresAt` reports when.

notifyType.description: Delivery channel. Ask the user; do not guess which destination they can read right now.

xid.description: The `xid` returned by kia_start_login. Sent with every OTP call.

name: kia_send_otp
